title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: approved Field Service time updates project task progress
summary: Hold: the risk rationale says progress changes only on approval, although the briefing itself correctly documents manual reprojection changing progress percentage. The documented controls, licensing and roadmap facts are supported; smaller corrections concern update timing, billing qualifications and the approval-review checklist.

claims.claim: The risk rationale says progress moves only when a project approver approves submitted time.
claims.quote: Rationale: 'progress moves only when a project approver approves time'. What's changing: 'a project manager can also reproject effort by updating Remaining Effort on a task, which recalculates the task's estimate at completion and progress percentage.'
claims.fix: Replace the risk rationale with: 'Low. The roadmap says no new execution logic or formulas are added, and Field Service time contributes actual effort only after approval.' This narrows the claim to the verified time-entry mechanism without denying the manual reprojection documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/project-operations/project-management/project-tracking-overview.

claims.claim: The checklist tells readers to review the Approvals view, but the controls table has no approval-review row.
claims.quote: Checklist: 'Review the Approvals view for submitted Field Service time that is still waiting'. Controls rows cover only integration enablement and integration-package installation.
claims.fix: Remove the After rollout bullet 'Review the Approvals view for submitted Field Service time that is still waiting, since it holds back task progress.' This removes the checklist/table mismatch without adding an unverified control row.
